mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku_customization_options (sku_id, customization_option_id, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{customizationOptionId}, #{isDeleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sku_customization_options AS sku_custom_opt SET sku_custom_opt.sku_id = #{skuId}, sku_custom_opt.customization_option_id = #{customizationOptionId}, sku_custom_opt.is_deleted = #{isDeleted}, sku_custom_opt.created_at = #{createdAt}, sku_custom_opt.updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE sku_custom_opt.id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sku_customization_options AS sku_custom_opt WHERE sku_custom_opt.id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT sku_custom_opt.id AS sku_custom_opt_id, sku_custom_opt.sku_id AS sku_custom_opt_sku_id, sku_custom_opt.customization_option_id AS sku_custom_opt_customization_option_id, sku_custom_opt.is_deleted AS sku_custom_opt_is_deleted, sku_custom_opt.created_at AS sku_custom_opt_created_at, sku_custom_opt.updated_at AS sku_custom_opt_updated_at FROM sku_customization_options AS sku_custom_opt WHERE sku_custom_opt.id = #{id}

SELECT sku_custom_opt.id AS sku_custom_opt_id, sku_custom_opt.sku_id AS sku_custom_opt_sku_id, sku_custom_opt.customization_option_id AS sku_custom_opt_customization_option_id, sku_custom_opt.is_deleted AS sku_custom_opt_is_deleted, sku_custom_opt.created_at AS sku_custom_opt_created_at, sku_custom_opt.updated_at AS sku_custom_opt_updated_at FROM sku_customization_options AS sku_custom_opt WHERE sku_custom_opt.sku_id = #{skuId} AND (sku_custom_opt.is_deleted IS NULL OR sku_custom_opt.is_deleted = 0)
